description: Data Dictionary entry: a DocType the AI may query, the fields it may use, and what they mean.

fields.description: For submittable DocTypes, only query submitted records (excludes drafts and cancelled).
fields.label: Submitted Records Only

fields.description: Parent DocType whose permissions apply, e.g. Sales Invoice for Sales Invoice Item.
fields.label: Parent DocType

fields.description: What this data represents and the rules for using it. Example: "Customer invoices = our revenue. Use base_grand_total for amounts in SAR. Exclude credit notes (is_return = 1) for gross sales. 'Overdue' means past due_date with outstanding_amount > 0."
fields.label: Description for AI

fields.description: One per line. Example: "Revenue by month this year" / "Top 10 customers by sales" / "Overdue invoices over 30 days"
fields.label: Sample Questions

fields.description: Only these fields can be selected, filtered or grouped by the AI. Use 'Load Fields' to fill from the DocType.
fields.label: Fields
